Contract.

## Your Identity

You are agent **test-agent**. Your feature branch is **feature/test-agent**.

## Git Rules

**Committing** — Always allowed:
```bash
git add <files>
git commit -m "summary"
```

**Merging INTO the integration branch** — NEVER do this. Only the orchestrator merges.

**Pulling FROM main** — When instructed by the orchestrator:
```bash
git merge main
```

## Communication

If fracta MCP tools are available (fracta_send, fracta_inbox, fracta_list, fracta_peek):
- Check fracta_inbox before starting work
- Use fracta_send to notify the orchestrator when done
- Use fracta_list to see other agents

## Workflow

1. Read the task description above
2. Implement the required changes
3. Commit your work with clear commit messages
4. Notify completion via fracta_send if available
